body.name: iStarZero
body.def: Enumerate \(\mathcal I_0\) canonically. If \(\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}=\varnothing\), choose its first member. Otherwise, for each component solve the finite exact rational program that maximizes \(\gamma\) subject to every nonredundant defining inequality having slack at least \(\gamma\) and \(0\le\gamma\le1\). Choose the first component with optimal \(\gamma>0\); if none exists, use the first nonempty component as a total fallback.
body.role: total geometry-selected component, with strictness proved downstream
